fixture: 320x180 24fps limited-range AV1 Main 8-bit repeated original compressed picture packets with continuous stereo Opus test tones
thermal: Every real software-budget observation must be nominal, low power disabled
freezeRule: For each observed maximum add 25% headroom, round up to 64KiB owned bytes, 1 frame, 4KiB for the largest non-frame allocation, and 1ms for rolling CPU and decode wall. Clamp to trial ceilings. Freeze before starting verification.
eligibility: A failed first process cannot define budgets. The second process must use the identical frozen executable, codec library, exact device, asset and the first process limits. Neither a prior debug observation nor a stand-alone bridge probe qualifies production.
